projection.description: Unmodified 26.2 renderer; only the main camera's projection matrix is replaced by a side-on orthographic projection centred on the camera eye with pixelsPerBlock window pixels per block. The vanilla perspective culling frustum is unchanged and contains the explosion.

scene.description: One explosion started through the vanilla ClientLevel.createFireworks with zero velocity. Every particle's RandomSource.create() in Particle.<init> is replaced by RandomSource.create(seeds.nextLong()) with seeds = RandomSource.create(seed) (ParticleSeedAgent); the random source algorithm stays vanilla. The client game timer runs only harness-requested ticks through the vanilla Minecraft.tick and reports partialTick 0. Frame tick-N is the scene after N client ticks since createFireworks.

scope: Projected references (ADR 0005): masked particle pixels of one firework explosion at every tick-aligned frame (partialTick 0) at the fixed seed; the backdrop is a declared web adaptation. Interpolated frames between ticks and other seeds are unverified. Captured on llvmpipe under Xvfb.

world.description: Fresh isolated singleplayer world from the vanilla world-creation flow: flat preset, fixed seed, spectator, peaceful, no structures. Noon with the clock paused, clear weather with the weather cycle paused, open sky around the explosion. options.txt sets no video option, so every video option is the vanilla default.
